title: Move/Rotate/Scale tool mouse box selection instead of tool usage
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.dev1.official [bf95b6258], v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e], v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1], v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], v4.5.rc1.official [08e9e6b29], v4.5.beta1.official [46c495ca2], v4.5.dev3.official [28089c40c]
- Not Reproducible in: v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6], v4.5.dev1.official [97241ffea], v4.5.dev2.official [af2c71397]

So between v4.5.dev2.official [af2c71397] and v4.5.dev3.official [28089c40c]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 09 Feb 2026 17:16:33 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (nvidia; 590.48.01) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 62.55 GiB memory

### Issue description

Before (for all tools):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7d825d9e-0539-4895-b304-4ee6124a78f6

Bug (for all tools), should not start a selection in the move tool:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/27bbb21d-5bfa-4f68-9641-40af5cd47546

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the Minimal project (Archive.zip), which is just a cube/meshinstance in a 3d scene
2. Just use the Move/Rotate/Scale Tool

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Archiv.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25375035/Archiv.zip)
